intro: Measured on one machine (Windows 11, Intel 13900K, RTX 4090) against the author's own retail console package. Every row below is an outcome the project produces, not a plan.

stages.evidence: the executable image maps at its preferred base, imports resolve through shims, static TLS is redirected, heap and file system come from the host
26,616 SPIR-V modules indexed; the boot loads 27,890 translated entries with 0 pipeline failures

device, queues, fences, allocators, heaps, command lists, the queue slot shift, the fence value address, the list lifecycle, the clear/barrier conversions, display resources and derived pipelines are measured and mapped
4,096 requests / 256 MiB decompressed at 131-144 MiB/s with every status entry S_OK; packed and swizzled reads refuse rather than guess
the title boots and runs its own loop past 300 s with no exception
frames record, close and submit with 0 failed Close calls and 0 refused submissions after the title page VAs were put into the GPU address space
all 10,241 graphics records build into real pipelines (0 refusals) and 41,545 derived pipelines are created (0 failures)
42,722 draws recorded and executed per 150 s run; the page pull feeds the buffers draws read (273 MiB per 300 s)
the runtime creates its own window and presents 33,275 frames per 300 s run with 0 failed present calls

the presented 4K image is written by the frame draws but reads back uniformly black; the pipeline stand-ins and the copy path are falsified, and the measured open leads are the texture-data source addresses and the unnamed consumer of the streamed blocks (docs/texture_import.md, docs/page_content.md)

counts.what: Draws recorded and executed per 150 s run

frontier.stop: no stop - the title boots, runs, executes its draws and presents frames to its own window; the presented frame is still black
frontier.summary: the title boots, runs past 300 s with no exception, executes its draws with 0 refused submissions and presents frames to the runtime's own visible window. The presented 4K image is proven writable and is the draw target, yet its own output reads back uniformly black; the fixed-function stand-ins and the copy path are falsified, and the measured remaining leads are the texture-data source addresses and the consumer of the streamed blocks.
